features.name: continuous_centroid_z_l2
features.description: Scale-normalized Euclidean distance from the training-fold mean profile over broad continuous descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth centrality coordinate so rows with similar standardized continuous profiles are closer under KNN.

features.name: sparse_count_centroid_z_l2
features.description: Scale-normalized Euclidean distance from the training-fold mean count profile over sparse integer descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates neighborhoods by count-pattern sparsity and outlying substructure counts.

features.name: low_range_prototype_distance
features.description: Distance to a generic low-magnitude descriptor prototype using training-fold lower and upper bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an unsupervised anchor that helps KNN organize rows near compact low-range profiles.

features.name: high_range_prototype_distance
features.description: Distance to a generic high-magnitude descriptor prototype using training-fold lower and upper bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an unsupervised anchor that helps KNN organize rows near extended high-range profiles.

features.name: size_polar_balance_similarity
features.description: Similarity score for the standardized balance between V8 and V1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps rows with comparable V8-to-V1 balance closer in the distance geometry.

features.name: functional_group_density_log
features.description: Log-scaled density of summed sparse count descriptors relative to broad size and shape descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact normalized coordinate for functional richness, reducing dominance by raw count magnitudes.

features.name: rare_motif_presence
features.description: Binary flag for any uncommon count indicator being present in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a simple neighborhood split for rows carrying rare motifs that can distort raw Euclidean distances.

features.name: electronic_shift_magnitude
features.description: Average absolute standardized shift for descriptors with signed or electronic character.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes neighborhoods sensitive to direction-independent electronic departures while limiting outlier impact.

features.name: shape_compactness_log_ratio
features.description: Log-scaled multiplicative ratio relating paired shape and topology continuous descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a bounded compactness axis that can improve local matching among similarly shaped profiles.

features.name: size_polarity_quadrant_code
features.description: Four-region unsupervised partition based on whether V30 and V8 are above their training-fold means.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a coarse neighborhood grouping for bulk and polarity patterns before fine distance comparisons.

features.name: expert_structural_complexity_score
features.description: Expert semantic score from 0 to 5 summarizing perceived molecular descriptor complexity from count richness, large continuous-size descriptors, and sparse motif diversity in the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an interpretable ordinal coordinate that can bring profiles with similar broad structural richness closer even when raw descriptor matches are imperfect.

features.name: expert_polar_functionality_score
features.description: Expert semantic score from 0 to 5 estimating how strongly the row suggests polar or hetero-atom functionality, using the balance of V8, V12, V14, V22, V28, and relevant count descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth chemistry-informed similarity axis for KNN when individual polar descriptors are noisy or sparse.
